name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with no more than two permanent functional wheels on the ground and a saddle, other than a moped: an electric two-wheeler whose motor input exceeds a moped's 1,500 watts is a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: No more than two permanent functional wheels on the ground, and a saddle
An electric motor input of more than 1,500 watts
Riders need a motorcycle (Class M) license; a beginner's permit is available from 15
Riders under 21 must wear an approved helmet with a chin or neck strap, and goggles or a face shield unless it has a windscreen
Titled and registered with the SCDMV every two years for $10, and must carry liability insurance
The moped definition starts above 750 W, so a throttle-driven electric bike of 750 W or less, which the electric-assist bicycle definition also excludes, fits neither category
South Carolina has no off-highway motorcycle category: its ATV law covers only vehicles on three or more wheels
